name: circle_beta_skeleton (circle-based beta-skeleton of a 2-D spatial point set)

benchmarks.note: deterministic LCG scatter in the unit square, fixed beta=2 (union-empty regime). The kernel is an O(n^2) candidate enumeration with an O(n) two-circle empty-region test per pair (2-D only), with an early break on the first blocking point. 50->200 (4x points) is ~30x time and 200->400 (2x points) is ~4.4x time, tracking the quadratic candidate count plus the growing per-pair scan

fixed 300-point LCG scatter, varying beta. Larger beta enlarges the union empty-region and yields a sparser graph, so most candidate pairs are non-edges whose empty-test scan early-breaks on the first blocker (beta=2 -> 0.67ms). Smaller beta (beta=0.5, the intersection-empty construction identical to the lune skeleton) yields a near-complete dense graph: most pairs are edges whose empty-test scan runs to completion with no early break, so cost balloons to ~56ms
